patthana15.16:1.1: hetuṃ maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana15.16:2.1: hetuṃ maggahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na maggahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana15.16:3.1: hetuṃ maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
